english.note: Use this when the facility specifically means the equipment or apparatus needed to provide a service.
Use this for installed or organizational equipment such as office, factory, or venue equipment rather than portable gear.
Use this in an industrial context for the machinery and other equipment used in production or construction.
Use this for equipment in general, including equipment used by the military.
